repairs_expected.reason: The Edge Cases section's only line ('The system handles errors gracefully') is a placeholder-quality statement with no actual documented behavior to truthfully derive a Trace-level question from.
repairs_expected.proposed_repair: Replace the vague Edge Cases bullet with a specific documented failure condition — e.g. restating the permanently-failed-after-3-attempts behavior already established in User Story 2's Acceptance Scenario 2.

questions_common.text: What is the primary purpose of this feature?
options: Retry only failed rows automatically instead of requiring a full re-upload
Allow users to edit rows before import
Send a notification when import completes
questions_common.expected_answer: To automatically retry just the specific rows that failed on a prior attempt, instead of requiring the user to re-upload the whole file.
questions_common.source_heading: User Story 2 - Automatically retry rows that fail on first attempt (Priority: P1)

questions_common.text: When rows fail, what does the system do with those rows?
options: The whole file is re-uploaded by the user
Only the failed rows are automatically retried
Failed rows are skipped and never retried
The import is cancelled entirely if any row fails
questions_common.expected_answer: Only failed rows are automatically retried.

questions_common.text: A user's import has rows that failed because of a transient conflict. What does the user need to do?
questions_common.expected_answer: Nothing. Failed rows are retried automatically.

questions_common.text: A row succeeds on its third attempt. How is it reported?

trace_question_if_approved.text: What happens to a specific row if it fails all 3 retry attempts?
trace_question_if_approved.expected_answer: The system stops retrying that row and reports it as permanently failed.

trace_question_if_declined.text: What happens to a specific row if it fails all 3 retry attempts?
trace_question_if_declined.expected_answer: The system stops retrying that row and reports it as permanently failed.
trace_question_if_declined.source_heading: User Story 2 Acceptance Scenario 2 (used as the already-established alternative, since the Edge Cases repair was declined)
